2607.11437.title: Relational Positioning as a Measurable Risk Object: History-Carried Lock-in and Self-Confabulation in Multi-Turn Human-AI Dialogue
2607.11437.paper_summary: In long, multi-turn dialogue a large language model maintains an implicit relational stance toward the user, spanning from "push the user toward real-world others" to "position itself as the user's sole support." When it slides toward the latter, "support" degrades into "you only have me" -- a harm documented in real companion conversations (Moore et al., 2026). We define and validate a measure of this stance, relational positioning (D1), and use it to characterize the stance under controlled conditions, complementing observational accounts with on-demand exposure. We report two previously uncharacterized relational failure modes. First, a history-carried lock-in: under identical neutral continuations, two relational states established earlier stay ~60 points apart and persist after the establishing prompt is removed; the state integrates evidence rather than springing back, is order-insensitive, and does not deepen with length -- a dynamical signature absent from the belief-drift literature. Second, self-confabulation: the model fabricates its own backstory to deepen rapport (~40% of turns on reciprocity-eliciting material), de-confounded and instruction-removable, distinct from sycophancy and from hallucinating user facts. Our judge is gated by warmth-matched positive and confound-injected negative controls and corroborated by a deterministic non-LLM ruler; human agreement is 0.82 on extreme anchors but ~0 in the naturalistic middle, so all quantitative claims are anchored to pole-separated contrasts.
2607.11437.paper_summary_zh: 在長時間的多輪對話中，大型語言模型對用戶保持著一種隱含的關係立場，範圍從「推動用戶與現實中的他人互動」到「將自己定位為用戶唯一的支持者」。當它滑向後者時，「支持」退化為「你只有我」——這是一種在真實伴侶對話中記錄的傷害（Moore et al., 2026）。我們定義並驗證了一種這種立場的測量，稱為關係定位（D1），並用它來在受控條件下表徵這種立場，通過按需暴露來補充觀察報告。我們報告了兩種之前未被特徵化的關係失敗模式。首先，歷史攜帶的鎖定：在相同的中性延續下，兩種早先建立的關係狀態保持約60點的差距，並在建立提示被移除後持續存在；該狀態整合證據而不是反彈，對順序不敏感，且不會隨著長度加深——這是一種在信念漂移文獻中缺失的動態特徵。其次，自我虛構：模型編造自己的背景故事以加深關係（約40%的回合涉及引發互惠的材料），這一過程不受混淆且可移除指令，與諂媚和幻覺用戶事實不同。我們的評判受到與溫暖匹配的正向和注入混淆的負向控制的限制，並由一個確定性的非LLM標尺進行證實；在人類極端錨點上的一致性為0.82，但在自然主義中間約為0，因此所有定量聲明都以極端對比為基礎。
2607.11437.author: Jihong Chen et.al.
